name: Bergen Spring 2025
information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Bergen Spring. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### Nye Deltakere Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenSpring2025#53891-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to to Bergen Spring! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete. ### New Competitors There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenSpring2025#53891-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.
